title: Choir and Wolf Revisited
author: Jude Montrose
blurb: Ivo Quintana, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
